record.name: Telegram
record.one_liner: Cloud-based instant messaging service and application programming interface provider.
record.access_note: Developers can obtain a bot token via @BotFather or an api_id and api_hash via my.telegram.org for free.
record.api_note: The Telegram Bot API and MTProto API provide comprehensive messaging, chat management, user authentication, and file transfer capabilities.

evidence.quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created.
Sign up for Telegram using an official application.
The Bot API allows you to easily create programs that use Telegram messages for an interface.
No — Telegram does not have an official MCP server.
You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
